It does not establish final-live damage, health, enemy count, spawn timing, route or full encounter survivability. The final-week video 7Lrst9SG3pk contains three kill rewards before its visible Warrior plate; the current staging lacks that Warrior because its activation and survival still conflict with the recorded sequence.
